risks: Out-of-state supplier (Tripura): website-only via bill-to-ship-to (docs/05); Rs 350 is 26.9% of Rs 1,299, just inside the ~29% guide - any cost increase, a higher-GST invoice or freight from Agartala breaks it
Volumetric weight: a 15 in oval tray with raised sides may bill at 1.5-3 kg dimensional weight; le_2kg assumed, get packed dimensions before costing; if it bills above 2 kg it fails policy

Amazon.in Habere round cane tray at Rs 1,098 (June 2026) is below the proposed Rs 1,299, and a Rs 269 Habere tray exists (size unknown); re-check live marketplace prices for a 14-15 in tray before sampling
Supplier cost is an unopened IndiaMART snippet with no MOQ; Assam alternative needs MOQ 50 - need a written quote for single-piece drop-ship from Agartala
Natural cane: mould in humid storage, weave breakage and crushed handles in transit drive returns; needs rigid carton and moisture protection
Do not claim 'food safe' or 'eco-friendly finish' without evidence; describe as a serving/decor tray
GST: cane/rattan basketwork (HSN 4602) assumed 12%, may be 5% after 22-09-2025; CA to confirm
Close in spirit to the sabai grass basket/wall-plate candidates already in the inbox (natural-fibre decor); reviewer to check it does not cannibalise them

review.notes: No hard-rule breach and no mass-marketplace tray of similar size found at or below Rs 700 (no Meesho or live Amazon.in/Flipkart price surfaced), but comparable cane trays sit at Rs 900-1,100 (Dastkar Rs 900/1,100; Amazon.in Habere Rs 1,098 in a June 2026 guide), so Rs 1,299 looks high: margin is 44.6% at Rs 1,299, 35.4% at Rs 1,099, and fails at Rs 999 (29.5%). The Rs 350 listing (15x10x2 in) is confirmed but its seller location (Tripura/Assam) is not, and the packed box can exceed 2 kg volumetric if the sides/handles are taller than ~2 in. Needed before approve: written single-piece drop-ship quote naming the seller's state, MOQ and GST, packed carton dimensions, and a live Amazon.in/Meesho price for a 14-15 in cane tray.

review.supplier_cost_check: IndiaMART cane-tray category (https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/cane-tray.html, WebSearch seen 2026-11-20) shows '15 Inch Oval Cane Tray Rs 350/Piece', dimensions 15x10x2 in, but the snippet does not show the seller's city, so the Tripura/Agartala origin is unverified. Assam alternative: Sumita Enterprise 14 in rattan cane tray Rs 380/piece, MOQ 50 (https://www.indiamart.com/sumita-enterprise-assam/cane-trays-planters.html). An Agartala seller (Craftscreation) lists an oval cane serving tray set of 3 at Rs 1,080. Listing prices only, not quotes.
review.volumetric_check: Divisor is L x W x H (cm) / 5000 for express, but Delhivery surface uses /4000 for shipments over 1 kg dead weight (https://help.delhivery.com/docs/calculating-volumetric-weight, seen 2026-11-20; Shiprocket calculator https://shiprocket.in/volumetric-weight-calculator uses /5000). Reviewer's estimate for the 15x10x2 in tray in a carton with ~1.5 cm padding (about 41x28x8 cm): 1.84 kg at /5000, 2.30 kg at /4000. With 4 in sides (about 41x28x13 cm): 2.98 kg at /5000. Stays within 2 kg only with a low (~2 in) tray, tight carton and an express (/5000) rate; packed dimensions needed.
